summary: No Book a Call while a campus is not Open: a campus page whose HubSpot Program type is Announced or Pre-Announcement shows no Book a Call control on any breakpoint (the widgets may keep their link but stay hidden on desktop, tablet and mobile); the control appears when the Program type becomes Open, where states.Open campus.hero.ctas is unchanged (present, campus-specific call_scheduling_link destination). A visible Book a Call on an Announced or Pre-Announcement page is a finding (check row campus.resources.booking.absent-before-open); the 2026-09-24 Lexington entry in registry/campus-cta-exceptions.json is kept and is now an instance of this rule

text:
Matt Barge, 2026-10-06, Claude Code coordinating session: "I don't think [a campus] should be able to book a call while it's only announced."

Rule as relayed to the website agent (run sweep-2026-10-06-D): a campus page whose HubSpot Program type is Announced (or Pre-Announcement) shows NO Book a Call CTA; it appears when the Program type becomes Open. Generalises the one-campus Lexington exception of 2026-09-24 (registry/campus-cta-exceptions.json campuses.boston-suburbs.book-a-call).
